description: This file declares the MiracastController class, which manages Miracast device discovery, connection, and control functionalities. It includes method declarations for device management, network configuration, and event handling, along with necessary includes and macros.

classes.name: MiracastController
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing Miracast device discovery, connections, P2P interactions, and session control.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MiracastController, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys the singleton instance of MiracastController.

methods.name: event_handler
methods.description: Handles various P2P events, triggering appropriate responses.

methods.name: connect_device
methods.description: Connects to a device with specified MAC and name.

methods.name: get_wfd_streaming_port_number
methods.description: Retrieves the port number for WFD streaming.

methods.name: get_connected_device_mac
methods.description: Returns MAC address of the connected device.

methods.name: get_allPeers
methods.description: Returns information about all peer devices.
